text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kobe Shimbun Hai has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka managed to regain her confidence at the summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She steps onto the track once again to ascertain whether she's running for the right reasons or not.
